steps.speaker: One Eyed Rosalee
steps.text: You're one to talk! I paid plenty for that little encounter!

steps.npc: One eye doesn't equal two of my best men!

steps.speaker: One Eyed Rosalee
steps.text: We gave you plenty of chances to flee!

steps.npc: If I ran away from you, I'd never hear the end of it!

steps.speaker: One Eyed Rosalee
steps.text: Really? Then what about that fight in the Turtle Belt?

steps.npc: That wasn't fleeing! It was a tactical repositioning! Besides, you're conveniently forgetting what happened at Brimhaven!

steps.speaker: One Eyed Rosalee
steps.text: A boring fight! I had better things to do.

steps.npc: Well, we'll have to make things more entertaining next time then!

steps.speaker: One Eyed Rosalee
steps.text: I look forward to it, but for now, let's drink!
